title: GHS Secure SDLC Evidence Explorer
oneLine: Federal-interview simulation of RBAC, STRIDE, OWASP coverage, secrets policy, and a role-change IR tabletop from a team learning-platform project.
role: Security-minded contributor on a team project (authorization, threat modeling, DevSecOps evidence).
evidenceRootNote: Paths are relative to the private local clone of the GHS Learning Platform team repo. Absolute Mac paths are listed only in D5/EVIDENCE.md (outside the public dist package).
limitations: Login-free portfolio simulation. Paraphrases private team-repo docs; no live backend, no code excerpts, no class data. Interactive allow/deny is a local model of documented deny-by-default RBAC plus Firestore ownership patterns.
